as_told.title: Lazar as limited hangout pushed out via John Lear

related.note: Both explain how Lazar's S-4 story got out as an intelligence move around 1988-89. The story says Lazar was pushed out after Lear gave files to Knapp; this telling says the leak was a planned release through someone with a poor reputation. These are competing core claims about the same event.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, offers his theory about Bob Lazar, a man who said in the late 1980s that he had worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site. Michels believes intelligence agencies pushed Lazar into public view after John Lear, whom he calls CIA-affiliated, passed files to the Las Vegas journalist George Knapp, around the same time as Majestic 12, papers said to describe a secret group of officials handling UFO matters. In another telling, Michels calls Lazar a "limited hangout", meaning a partial truth released on purpose to hide a bigger one.
